name: Artesunate
status: DRAFT – pharmacology (†) is not yet checked against the package insert; doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text
dagger_note: † = general pharmacology; not in the SA guideline and not yet checked against the package insert
item_format: t=text, s=source:printed page, d=dagger, b=bold, h=heading

moa.t: Generates free radicals in the parasite, rapidly clears all blood stages

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Artesunate, IV, 2.4 mg/kg at 0, 12 and 24 hours; then daily until patient is able to tolerate oral therapy. · Administer at least 3 IV doses before switching to oral
 If parenteral artesunate is not available: • Quinine, IV (1 mL = 300 mg quinine salt). • Loading dose: 20 mg/kg in dextrose 5% administered over 4 hours.
Artesunate, IM or IV, 2.4 mg/kg at hours 0, 12 and 24, then daily until patient is able to tolerate oral treatment.
Artesunate, IM or IV, 3 mg/kg at hours 0, 12 and 24, then daily until patient is able to tolerate oral treatment.

adjustments.t: Treatment of choice for severe malaria in all trimesters

cautions.t: Follow with a full oral artemisinin combination course

adverse_effects.t: Delayed haemolysis 1–3 weeks after treatment, dizziness, GI upset

monitoring.t: Haemoglobin at 14 days, glucose, parasite count
